correlation.fft_accumulation: Sums of cross-products, power and fourth moments; flags after whole integration
correlation.clock_model: Supplied linear ADC mapping; no automatic weak-source clock recovery
correlation.geometry: Sample alignment and RF rephasing; linear delay over <=1s, <=600m
correlation.weight_note: 2*valid FFT blocks / product of measured station channel powers; weak-source quadrature approximation; filtered FFT correlations not fully modeled

scope: One existing 8-station 1-second VDIF record, known reference output. Source workflow RSS includes Python/Astropy; no previous whole-array RSS benchmark. No continuous long-observation throughput claim.
